personality: 3 Editorial Mobile with custom Steampunk/Parchment fusion
personality_one_liner: Warm, ornate, industrial-elegant steampunk aesthetic using parchment, brass, wood, and glowing aether motifs.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for editorial feel. Intentional padding around cards.

do's: Use subtle blur over hero banners and header backdrops
Apply over decorative spinning gears in hero backgrounds
dont's: Do not use blur aggressively to override the 'parchment' tactile texture. Keep it selective.

screens.name: Social Feed
screens.purpose: A central hub for reading updates, viewing stories, and composing new thoughts.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty parchment page with 'No dispatches yet.'
states.error: Error message with 'Reignite the boiler' retry button.

screens.layout: Top row horizontal scroll for 'Stories'. Underneath, a Composer block. Main content is a vertical list of Feed Post Cards. Post Cards use panel layout: surfaceSecondary background, 1px border, md (14px) radius. Microcopy like 'Chatmonger' for comments.

screens.name: Districts Directory
screens.purpose: A hub to browse and discover the 22 thematic districts.
screens.layout: Grid of District Grid Cards. Wrap with flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', space-between. Each card width ~48%, containing a featured image, name, and tagline in uppercase tracked-out eyebrow label format.

screens.name: District Detail
screens.purpose: Deep-dive into a specific district's features and its chatmonger.
screens.layout: Hero background with decorative spinning gears and gradient plate. Features grid below it. Chatmonger character card (using aether-glow shadow and brass plate). A 'Nearby Districts' horizontal scrolling section at the bottom.

screens.name: Bazaar
screens.purpose: Marketplace for browsing and purchasing eclectic goods.
screens.layout: Multi-column grid (2-col) of marketplace product listings. Cards use 1px border and soft 'forge' shadow. Each card features an antique product photo, brass-gradient title (h4 size, Cinzel), and a primary brass-gold CTA button.

screens.name: Profile HQ
screens.purpose: User's personal hub and Konphlux ID.
screens.layout: Konphlux ID showcased prominently as a detailed panel card with rivets motif. Settings menu listed vertically below with MaterialCommunityIcons for each row.

hero_gears_brass.alt: Close-up of intricate clockwork gears and clock face

bazaar_product.alt: silver pocket watch on brown textile

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly match the steampunk UI motifs requested: 'Panel' cards with 'surfaceSecondary' bg, 1px 'border', 'md' (14px) radius, and soft shadow. Use the 'brandTertiary' (#2E7FC9) as the glow color for 'aether glowing blue' shadows on featured panels.

Typography: Use 'Cinzel' for headers (H1-H4) and the brand logo with letter-spacing -0.01em. Use 'Karla' for body text. Eyebrow labels should be tiny uppercase with letter-spacing (0.24-0.32em) and muted text ('onSurfaceSecondary' with lower opacity).
Microcopy matters: Strictly use Victorian whimsy texts for placeholders, empty states, and buttons (e.g. 'Forge your Konphlux ID', 'Enter with your Konphlux ID', 'Chatmonger', 'Artificer').
Use 'MaterialCommunityIcons' since it provides the best icons for steampunk aesthetics like cogs, compasses, scrolls, and gears.

Use linear-gradients generously for 'brass gradient plates' on avatars and badges using stops derived from 'brand' and 'brandPrimary'. Apply text gradient masks (using @react-native-masked-view/masked-view + expo-linear-gradient) for large headings to create a 'brass-text' effect.

All image backgrounds MUST have the standard vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast. Overlay images with the parchment_texture at 10-15% opacity to add tactile feel if possible.
Ensure both Light Mode (parchment) and Dark Mode (dark wood/leather) color maps are implemented. The provided token map includes the exact hexes.
